items.source: The template can be accessed through the couchbaseTemplate and reactiveCouchbaseTemplate beans out of your context. Once you’ve got a reference to it, you can run all kinds of operations against it. Other than through a repository, in a template you need to always specify the target entity type which you want to get converted.
items.translation: 该模板可通过上下文中的 couchbaseTemplate 和 reactiveCouchbaseTemplate Bean 进行访问。 一旦获得其引用，即可针对它执行各种操作。 除了通过 Repository 之外，在模板中始终需要明确指定您希望转换的目标实体类型。

items.source: The motivation behind mapping to Spring’s consistent data access exception hierarchy is to let you write portable and descriptive exception handling code without resorting to coding against and handling specific Couchbase exceptions. All of Spring’s data access exceptions are inherited from the DataAccessException class, so you can be sure that you can catch all database-related exceptions within a single try-catch block.
items.translation: 将映射到 Spring 的一致的数据访问异常层次结构背后的动机，是为了让您能够编写可移植且描述清晰的异常处理代码，而无需针对特定的 Couchbase 异常进行编码和处理。Spring 的所有数据访问异常都继承自DataAccessException类，因此您可以确信能够在单个 try-catch 块中捕获所有与数据库相关的异常。

items.source: The template provides lower level access to the underlying database and also serves as the foundation for repositories. Any time a repository is too high-level for you needs chances are good that the templates will serve you well. Note that you can always drop into the SDK directly through the beans exposed on the AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration.
items.translation: 该模板提供了对底层数据库的较低级别访问，同时也是仓储的基础。 如果某个仓储对您而言过于高级，那么模板很可能非常适合您的需求。请注意，您始终可以通过在AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration上暴露的 Bean 直接切换到 SDK。

items.source: Couchbase supports Sub-Document Operations. This section documents how to use it with Spring Data Couchbase.
items.translation: Couchbase 支持子文档操作。本节介绍如何在 Spring Data Couchbase 中使用该功能。

items.source: The Spring Framework provides exception translation for a wide variety of database and mapping technologies. This has traditionally been for JDBC and JPA. Spring Data Couchbase extends this feature to Couchbase by providing an implementation of the org.springframework.dao.support.PersistenceExceptionTranslator interface.
items.translation: Spring Framework 为各种数据库和映射技术提供了异常转换功能。 传统上，该功能针对的是 JDBC 和 JPA。 Spring Data Couchbase 将此功能扩展至 Couchbase，通过提供 org.springframework.dao.support.PersistenceExceptionTranslator 接口的实现来实现这一目标。

items.source: ReactiveCouchbase propagates exceptions as early as possible. Exceptions that occur during the processing of the reactive sequence are emitted as error signals.
items.translation: ReactiveCouchbase 尽可能早地传播异常。 在响应式序列处理过程中发生的异常将以错误信号的形式发出。

items.source: Sub-Document operations may be quicker and more network-efficient than full-document operations such as upsert or replace because they only transmit the accessed sections of the document over the network.
items.translation: 子文档操作可能比全文档操作（如更新或替换）更快且更节省网络资源，因为它们仅通过网络传输文档中被访问的部分。

items.source: Sub-Document operations are also atomic, in that if one Sub-Document mutation fails then all will, allowing safe modifications to documents with built-in concurrency control.
items.translation: 子文档操作也是原子的，这意味着如果其中一个子文档的变更失败，则所有变更都将失败，从而允许对文档进行安全的修改并内置并发控制。

items.source: Currently Spring Data Couchbase supports only sub document mutations (remove, upsert, replace and insert).
items.translation: 目前，Spring Data Couchbase 仅支持子文档的变更操作（包括删除、更新插入、替换和插入）。

items.source: Mutation operations modify one or more paths in the document. The simplest of these operations is upsert, which, similar to the fulldoc-level upsert, will either modify the value of an existing path or create it if it does not exist:
items.translation: 突变操作会修改文档中的一个或多个路径。其中最简单的操作是 upsert，它与 fulldoc 级别的 upsert 类似，如果路径已存在则修改其值，否则创建该路径：

items.source: Following example will upsert the city field on the address of the user, without trasfering any additional user document data.
items.translation: 以下示例将更新用户地址中的城市字段，而不会传输任何其他用户文档数据。

items.source: Multiple Sub-Document operations can be executed at once on the same document, allowing you to modify several Sub-Documents at once. When multiple operations are submitted within the context of a single mutateIn command, the server will execute all the operations with the same version of the document.
items.translation: 可以在同一文档上同时执行多个子文档操作，从而允许您一次性修改多个子文档。当在单个 mutateIn 命令上下文中提交多个操作时，服务器将使用文档的同一版本执行所有操作。

items.source: To execute several mutation operations the method chaining can be used.
items.translation: 可以使用方法链来执行多个变异操作。
